privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: FilePilot is built so that your documents stay yours. Here is exactly what happens to your files.
privacy.processingBody: Compression, resizing, conversion and every PDF operation run on your phone. FilePilot has no server and never uploads your files.
privacy.lifecycleBody: 1. You pick a file in Android's file picker: FilePilot gets a temporary private copy. 2. The copy is processed in a private temporary folder. 3. The result is saved in FilePilot's private storage. 4. Temporary copies are deleted when you leave the tool, and again at every app start. Your original file is only read, never modified.
privacy.storageBody: Results stay in FilePilot's private app storage, which other apps can't read, until you delete them (from a result, the history or Settings). "Save to device" writes a copy to a folder you choose.
privacy.sharingBody: When you share a result, Android gives the app you choose temporary read access to that single file. Internal storage paths are never exposed.
privacy.historyBody: The history stores the operation type, file names, sizes, date and status on your device only. It never contains file contents. You can clear it anytime.
privacy.analyticsBody: Off by default. If you turn it on, FilePilot counts anonymous events such as "compression completed". It never sends file names, file contents or document metadata.
privacy.adsBody: The free version shows Google AdMob ads, with consent requested where the law requires it. Ads never see your files. Premium removes ads.
privacy.purchasesBody: Payments are handled by Google Play. FilePilot only receives whether Premium is active.
privacy.permissionsBody: FilePilot doesn't ask for access to your photos or storage: you choose each file in Android's picker, which grants access to that file only.
privacy.rightsBody: Delete results one by one, clear the history, or use "Delete all my data" in Settings. Uninstalling FilePilot also removes its private storage.
